title: Target Plastic Model Explorer
description: An auditable Streamlit implementation of the Target Plastic Model. Its primary workflow converts measured plastic-associated concentrations to toxic units, mixture toxic units, plastic-phase PNEC equivalents, and risk quotients without requiring chemical-specific LC50 or plastic-water partition coefficients. It also provides source-aware acute fish evidence, validation diagnostics, critical-burden exploration, polymer selection, and passive-dosing design.
